name: Japan Property Management Center
summary: Japan Property Management Center Co., Ltd. specializes in the subleasing of real estate, encompassing both newly constructed and pre-owned apartments and condominiums. Its extensive operations also include comprehensive rental housing management, principal investments, and a range of complementary rental management services. The company further operates within the insurance sector. JPMC actively develops and markets rental broadband systems as well as flooring materials, and provides financing solutions tailored for rental property administration. Beyond these services, it organizes and conducts seminars, and is dedicated to the planning, development, and research of innovative real estate management offerings. JPMC also undertakes construction contracts for property remodeling associated with rental properties and delivers expert consulting. Founded in 2002, the firm is based in Tokyo, Japan.
